steps.en: Install the CLI, set up the engine and download a licensed model
steps.zh: 安装命令行、配置引擎并下载许可合适的模型

steps.en: Supply text, an authorized reference voice and an output WAV path
steps.zh: 提供文字、获授权的参考声音和 WAV 输出路径

steps.en: Load the matching local audio.cpp engine and generate audio
steps.zh: 加载匹配的本地引擎并生成音频

steps.en: Validate the partial WAV and publish the output with JSON results
steps.zh: 校验临时 WAV 并输出成品与 JSON 结果

value.en: Create local narration without maintaining a Python model environment
value.zh: 无需维护 Python 模型环境即可生成本地旁白
